findings.text: follow-on: the rewritten comment claims a held settle row "is never released" once a later row shows its run in a live pane word, but the branch at reckon/crew/ticker.py:1543 releases it at once (out.append(opener)) when that word differs from the one the pane shows, and the same commit's docstring at tests/test_a_halt_the_run_left_is_not_drawn.py:7 says plainly that the held row prints then; the "plain statement" this commit exists to make is wrong for one of its three cases.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base d31cd5907738b4408995862abfc13580eb3aca80; the single commit 911f02031 rewrites a 4-line comment at reckon/crew/ticker.py:1059, the test module docstring, one case docstring, and the SESSION/RUN/PROJECT/NODE fixture literals at tests/test_a_halt_the_run_left_is_not_drawn.py:24-27 — no assertion and no executable line changes.
item_verdicts.done_when: §29's done_when names tests/test_a_halt_the_run_left_is_not_drawn.py; the manifest records its rerun at head 911f020 as 4 passed EXIT=0 in logs/halt-run-left-hygiene.log, which I reproduced (4 passed in 0.76s), and the done_when's "no added failure against base" clause is not re-measured for this commit.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is that a held settle row is never released once a later row moves its run on to a live pane word; the commits gained since the last review (base d31cd59) only neutralise the incident naming the landed change carried, rewriting reckon/crew/ticker.py:1059 and tests/test_a_halt_the_run_left_is_not_drawn.py:1-27 with no executable statement changed.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it names both commits, the 79-passed gate at d31cd59, the 4-passed rerun at 911f020, the base/head importer arms and the negative control log, and every log it names exists on disk.
item_verdicts.write_paths: §29 declares reckon/crew/ticker.py and tests/test_a_halt_the_run_left_is_not_drawn.py; git diff --stat d31cd59..911f020 lists exactly those two files and nothing else.

justifications.durability: the diff adds no assertion, and the guard at tests/test_a_halt_the_run_left_is_not_drawn.py:88 still reddens under the recorded mutation (logs/negative-control-mutated.log, EXIT=1) while I reproduced it green at head (4 passed), so the fixture rename left the behaviour covered.
justifications.evidence: the commit's own check is the rerun of tests/test_a_halt_the_run_left_is_not_drawn.py recorded in logs/halt-run-left-hygiene.log (4 passed, EXIT=0) at head 911f020, but no gate asserts the commit's own goal, that no incident identifier survives in the changed source.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/ticker.py:1061 says the held row "is never released" once a later row shows a live word, contradicting ticker.py:1543, where that same branch appends the held opener to the pane, and contradicting this commit's own docstring at tests/test_a_halt_the_run_left_is_not_drawn.py:7.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/ticker.py:1059-1062 and tests/test_a_halt_the_run_left_is_not_drawn.py:1-9 state the settle rule without the incident run, project or node ids, which is what the commit set out to do, though ticker.py:1061 misstates one branch.
justifications.reuse: the commit adds no definition at all — the only identifiers it touches are the test-local fixtures at tests/test_a_halt_the_run_left_is_not_drawn.py:24-27 — so no capability is forked or duplicated by this change.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat d31cd59..911f020 lists only reckon/crew/ticker.py (10 changed lines) and tests/test_a_halt_the_run_left_is_not_drawn.py (32), both declared write paths, and touches nothing else.
